description: Dock workers strike at Port of Rotterdam halting all container operations. Estimated 72-hour closure.
Typhoon Mawar forcing vessel rerouting. All shipping lanes between Hong Kong and Manila closed.
Canal closure due to regional conflict. All vessels diverting via Cape of Good Hope adding 10-14 days.
ILWU slowdown at Port of Los Angeles causing 4-6 day processing delays for inbound containers.
Hurricane warning in Gulf of Mexico. Offshore and coastal shipping suspended.
